description: Fused register/SMEM-resident Householder megakernel for the small launch-bound shapes (n=32 B=20, n=176 B=40, n=352 B=40): one CTA per matrix, the WHOLE unblocked Householder factorization (column norms, reflector form, rank-1 trailing updates) lives in one persistent kernel with the panel cached in SMEM/registers, zero per-column kernel-launch storm and zero host sync. Emit (H,tau) in place. Target the per-launch overhead that dominates these tiny-n shapes.

Trial 1: fused SMEM-resident Householder megakernel, one CTA/matrix, column-major SMEM. Routes n in {32,176} to custom kernel; n=352 and all other n to geqrf. n=32 324->72us (4.5x), n=176 21729->1756us (12.4x). Validate PASS incl all 3 guards. nsys: single qr_megakernel, ~1.75ms/call min on n=176 (40 CTAs only, 27% SM-level occupancy per launch).

Trial 3: blocked compact-WY Householder (NB=32) for n>32, scalar-thread block update C-=V(T^T(V^T C)). Validate PASS. REGRESSION: n=176 1733->2949us (loop-l-outer contiguous) / 2191us (loop-i-outer); scalar block update touches each trailing column NB times vs once/reflector unblocked, adding memory traffic. Confirms WY blocking needs tensor-core GEMMs to pay off. geomean 97705us. Best so far remains trial 2 unblocked 93268us.

Trial 4: fused unblocked, serial next-column norm + in-place v (no s_v buffer), T=512/1024. Validate PASS. n=176 1733->1971us REGRESSION: serial single-thread norm of col j+1 becomes the barrier straggler. n=32 70->74us. geomean 94988us. Lesson: keep norm parallel. Best remains trial2 unblocked 93268.

Trial 5: clean unblocked, parallel block-reduction norm + in-place v (read v from col_j, no s_v buffer/barrier). T=512 for n=176. Validate PASS. n=176 1733->1695us, geomean 93268->92764us (new best). n=32 unchanged path.

Trial 6: hybrid warp-0 panel factor (warp-sync) + CTA-wide WY block update, NB=32. Validate PASS. n=176 1695->3386us REGRESSION: serializes all reflector formations onto 1 warp (7/8 idle), costing more than the barriers saved. geomean 98243us. Best remains trial5 unblocked 92764. Lesson: barrier reduction must not sacrifice reflector-formation parallelism.

Trial 8: 2-barrier/column unblocked - warp 0 fuses col j+1's norm^2 (parallel warp-reduce) into reflector j's update, removing the next block reduction; + 1-barrier block reduce. n=176 1637us (from 1687), n=32 59.1us (from 63.6), geomean 91830 (from 92591). New best. Validate PASS.

Trial 9: n=352 via L2-resident global working buffer (495KB>SMEM), 2-barrier unblocked. n=352 50878->33047us (1.54x). geomean 88367 (from 91830). n=32 59us, n=176 1637us unchanged. Validate PASS incl guards. n=352 win is smaller (1.5x vs n=176's 12x) because L2 latency >> SMEM; SMEM-panel-blocking or a 2-CTA cluster should help much more.

Trial 10: n=352 SMEM-panel-blocked (panel staged in SMEM, factored 2-barrier, trailing block-updated in L2), NB=32, T=256 + launch_bounds(256,1) to avoid LaunchOutOfResources. Validate PASS. n=352 33047->35821us REGRESSION: scalar block update reads each trailing col NB=32x from L2 (= n unblocked passes) + stage overhead. geomean 89061. Best n=352 stays trial9 L2 unblocked 33047us. Confirms blocking (n=176 AND n=352) needs tensor cores.

Trial 11: pad SMEM leading dimension to odd (LDA=n|1) to kill 2-way bank conflicts in the trailing update. HUGE: n=176 1637->559us (2.9x), n=32 60->33us (1.8x). n=352 (L2 global, no pad yet) 35599us. geomean 77588 (from 89061), 1.69x from baseline. Validate PASS. Bank conflicts were the hidden cost, not just barriers.

Trial 12: T=1024 for n=352 global kernel (ncu: 67.8% load-scoreboard-stalled, 8 warps too few to hide L1/L2 latency). n=352 35745->32991us. n=176 558, n=32 33. geomean 77097. n=352 still latency-bound on the serial column chain; SMEM-tiled block update is the next lever.

Trial 13: n=352 panel-blocked, single-pass (row-outer) block update so each trailing col is read twice/panel from L2 (V hot in SMEM) vs NB re-reads. n=352 32991->10001us (3.3x; 5.1x from baseline). n=176 558, n=32 33. geomean 69763 = 1.88x from baseline. Validate PASS. NB=32, T=256.

Trial 14: n=352 panel-width NB sweep {8,16,32,64}. NB=16 best (panel factor shorter + w[NB]/y[NB] regs smaller -> higher occupancy; barrier/occupancy-bound not L2-bound). n=352 10001->7896us. n=176 558, n=32 33. geomean 68209 = 1.92x from baseline. Validate PASS.

Trial 15: n=352 panel kernel T sweep with launch_bounds. T=512 (16 warps) best: 7896->7259us (T=128 slower block update 9321; T=1024 wrong results under 64-reg cap). n=176 558, n=32 33. geomean 67719 = 1.94x from baseline. Validate PASS.

Trial 16: n=352 panel factored entirely in warp 0 (warp-sync, zero __syncthreads in panel) + full-CTA single-pass block update. Cuts panel barriers from ~32/panel to ~4/panel (stage/factor/writeback/update). n=352 7259->6381us. n=176 558, n=32 33. geomean 67157 = 1.95x from baseline. Validate PASS. NB=16, T=512.

Trial 17: removed the panel-writeback __syncthreads in the n=352 kernel (writeback and block update touch disjoint gW columns). Neutral on n=352 (6381us, barrier wasn't a bottleneck) but a correct simplification. geomean ~67358 (n=32/n=176 run noise). Validate PASS.

Trial 18: n=352 2-CTA CLUSTER (cg cluster, DSMEM map_shared_rank for V/T, block update split across 2 CTAs / 80 SMs). Validates correct incl all guards. n=352 6381->7412us REGRESSION: cluster.sync overhead + CTA1 idle during serial panel factor + DSMEM latency > the halved block update. geomean ~67996. Cluster needs the panel factor ALSO parallelized across the cluster to pay off. Best remains single-CTA panel 6381us / geomean 67181.

Trial 19: clean final - removed dead kernels (cluster/global/hybrid/blocked), live path = qr_unblocked (n=32,176) + qr_panel (n=352). n=32 32.8us (9.8x), n=176 558us (39x), n=352 6377us (8.0x). geomean 67138 = 1.95x from baseline. Validate PASS incl all guards.

Fused SMEM/L2-resident Householder megakernel delivered on all 3 small launch-bound shapes. BEST commit 186ad6fec, geomean 131145->67138us = 1.95x from baseline. Per-shape (one CTA/matrix, compact LAPACK (H,tau)): n=32 324->32.8us (9.8x), n=176 21729->558us (39x), n=352 50878->6377us (8.0x). All validate PASS incl the 3 shipped guards (off-grid n->geqrf, diff-correctness, invariance); off-grid/n>=512 route to torch.geqrf untouched. Live path: qr_unblocked (n<=176, whole matrix in column-major SMEM) + qr_panel<16> (n=352, panel staged+factored in SMEM by warp 0 with warp-sync, trailing block-updated in an L2-resident buffer with a single-pass row-outer w/update). WHAT MOVED THE NUMBER (biggest first): (1) odd-padded SMEM leading dim LDA=n|1 killed 2-way bank conflicts -> n=176 1637->559us (2.9x) and n=32 60->33us, the single biggest win; (2) panel-blocked single-pass (row-outer) block update for n=352 -> 33k->10k us (each trailing col read 2x/panel from L2 vs NB re-reads); (3) NB=16 + T=512 + warp-0 panel factor for n=352 -> 10k->6.4k us. ncu: all 3 shapes are CTA-BARRIER-bound on the serial n-column dependency with 1 CTA/SM and SM-STARVED (20/40/40 matrices on 148 SMs); compute <10%, so TENSOR CORES are NOT the lever here (confirmed by profiles, not assumed). REGRESSIONS measured & discarded: scalar WY block update (no tensor cores adds memory traffic), hybrid/warp-0-only panel for n=176 (serializes reflector formation), serial next-col norm fusion, multi-accumulator ILP, 2-CTA cluster (cluster.sync+DSMEM overhead + CTA1 idle during the SERIAL panel factor outweighs the halved block update -> 6.4k->7.4k). OPEN DIRECTIONS for follow-up briefs: (a) a cluster where BOTH CTAs cooperate on the panel factor too (not just the block update) - the current cluster regressed only because the panel factor stayed serial on CTA0; (b) warp-0 doing 2+ next-columns cooperatively for n=176 (fuse 2 norms); (c) extend the panel-blocked+warp-0 design to n>=512 (other briefs' shapes); (d) tensor-core GEMM for the n=352 w=V^T C / C-=V Y block update (untested whether it helps the barrier/L2-bound regime); (e) cublasSgeqrfBatched as a library alternative (deliberately not used - off the megakernel brief). NOTE: the leaderboard 'stream' substring ban also scans COMMENTS - the word 'streamed' in a comment failed validate once; avoid 'stream' anywhere in submission.py.
